TEXT:
For the sake of gathering data for the new game, 
we ended up in... Well, it's not anywhere special, it's 
just the same old familiar Akihabara.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, you're late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No I'm not. I'm right on time.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You're 20 seconds late. In times like this, it's best to 
arrive at least 5 minutes early.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, yeah, you sure pay attention to the trivial 
things. Now, we better get going before your 
schedule's all ruined.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Okay, let us depart-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Ugh, again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: No... It's nothing.
As she said that, Sena replied to a text. Soon after...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What, it's mine this time?

The text I received was from Akagi. It said, "Are 
you really together with Sena-chan?"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Hey, did you send Akagi a text saying we were 
together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes, I got a text that said, "Sena-chan, where are 
you?" so that's how I replied.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Check this out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...? Eh, isn't this from Onii-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I can't tell if your brother is a real worrywart, or...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: He really doesn't trust me, that Onii-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. It's been bad lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
When Onii-chan isn't around, he gets worked up 
worrying if you're clinging to another guy... He must 
be nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Not me![/font_size] He's worrying about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Huh? Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
*sigh*... We haven't even gone anywhere and I 
already feel exhausted...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm sorry, because of Onii-chan...

It's not just your brother, you're at fault too. It 
sure is complicated getting between these two 
siblings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, well... it's probably best to resolve this 
misunderstanding to clear his suspicions. I'll reply 
saying you're hanging out with me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah, then how about this, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Come over here for a bit.

Sena grabbed onto my arm. Her chest was rubbing 
up against it.

Is this brat doing this on purpose? Cause it feels 
great, so more, please... Just as my mind went wild-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If we send a photo of the two of us together, even 
Onii-chan won't get suspicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A...Ah, sure.

...Her face... Her face is too close. Smells kinda good 
though. As expected from a girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: U-Uh, it's nothing.

Man, seriously... The two of us taking a photo 
together... What are we, lovers? My heart's beating 
like crazy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Since that's done, let's depart on our study trip!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I absolutely have to get you to 
[font_size=28]understand[/font_size] BL!

Yeah, that's right... Coming to Akiba with her at this 
stage, I can't imagine this as a date.
Why? Because she's rotten to the core.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I'm a bit of an omnivore so I would go for anything, 
but I think you're the type to mix a lot of genres 
together...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
The world of BL is deep beyond measure! 
Welcome! I invite you to the dazzling world of male 
bonding!
I-I don't wanna enter this world of male bonding...

Should I ask Akagi if he has any tips on how to 
deal with Sena?
...Oh, speak of the devil, he texted me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
You're too close to my angel!!! Stop acting 
love-struck and find the perpetrator already!!
And... he's flipping out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, come on, over here!

I'm out of options. I can't talk to Akagi, so it's time 
to prepare myself for the worst...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Hey, check out this character's muscular body!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You sound like some kind of e-commerce director, 
getting worked up like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If you buy this game right now, I'll throw in an 
absolutely filthy doujinshi set!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not buying it, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But wait, there's more! Recommended for 
beginners, it comes with another doujinshi featuring 
a middle-aged character beautified up to 120%!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Thanks for being considerate, but I'm definitely not 
buying it, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I, Akagi Sena, will shoulder the burden of the 
interest rates as well as the cost!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So you already planned on buying it all!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ehehe, I'm going to the register!

Geez, this girl... when you think everyone around you has 
similar hobbies, you go on as much as you want. If we're  
gonna make this game, I have to suppress this part of her...
I don't know why I have to be here though!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, over here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What is it this time...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
There's a drama CD I've been wanting for you to 
hear... There's a demo here, so give it a listen!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright already...

This situation kinda reminds me of when Kirino and 
I first started playing H-games together.

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_A
TEXT:
Yes... open up your throat and drink it all up. My 
Longinus spear...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_B
TEXT: I-Impossible... It's way too big...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]Impossible?! That's my line! I can't 
stand listening to this![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Now, now, just give it another listen... after all, this 
CD...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What's with that bold grin?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
These voice actors' voices sounds really familiar 
huh? President and Makabe-senpai...

With Sena constantly pushing me on, I put the 
headphones on again...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_A
TEXT:
I'm gonna plug it up... this mouth that constantly 
teases me...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_B
TEXT: Eek, please don't... punish me... Ah, President...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Did he just say President!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[font_size=33]Exactly!![/font_size] Even the premise is 
exactly the same! Those two...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
The president who daydreams but is aggressive in bed, 
together with the cutie who makes rude remarks being on 
the receiving end... [font_size=31]Oo[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=22]hi[/font_size]hi[font_size=22]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=31]hi[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=22]hi[/font_size]hi[font_size=22]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size]
A demonic smile popped up on her face...

Where did the cute underclassman that I met at 
the station disappear to...

Then again, I felt a great urge to retreat as we 
approached the goods.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Y-You know, we can research this without plunging 
right into the thick of things, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Eh-, don't stand so far away and gawk, come closer 
please. There's a drama CD I absolutely want you 
to hear.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
N-No thanks, I don't want to get in too deep today, 
so let's stop here! Baby steps, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Really...? The voice actor sounds exactly like 
Makabe-senpai, it's really interesting.

Yeah well... that does sound interesting, but it doesn't 
sound like something I have to experience.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, I guess this is good for starters. Even Onii-chan 
watched from afar at first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay. Sorry.
Phew. Looks like I succeeded in avoiding danger...

With Sena in a satisfied trance, the Akiba BL tour 
was over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Um... Senpai. There is one more thing I need to do in 
Akiba. If possible, I would like your help...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What is it? If it isn't about BL then I'll help.

With how things have turned out, my precautions 
have gotten stronger.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I want to... buy Onii-chan a present before I head 
back home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: For Akagi? Is his birthday coming up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...No, it's a makeup present.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
After hearing what you had to say, I gave a lot of 
thought about Onii-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
It's true that Onii-chan is creepy, and it was 
annoying how persistent his texts were... Still, he's 
really kind to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: He's my precious Onii-chan... That's what I felt.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Therefore, I want to buy him a present as an 
apology for avoiding him.

She looked up to me with a worried face, and I 
was plunged into her eyes-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hnnnnnnnnnnng!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...? What's the matter, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, nothing... It's nothing!

She's so cute it's illegal? Somebody else's little 
sister can't be this cute!

Her mannerisms and behavior are nice. My sister 
could learn a thing or two.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
So, how about it, Senpai... Will you accompany me 
to buy a present?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, of course. If it's to help both of you reconcile, 
then it all works out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ehehe, thanks a lot. You're really nice, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No way.

Well I did give both of them life counseling. If 
everything ends well, the counseling was worth it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Thank goodness... I don't really know what would 
make him happy, I had some trouble over what to 
buy him.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You've gone to Akiba with him before, so you 
should know what kind of present he would like?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that's right. When I was with him-

Thinking back, we stood in front of a large adult 
goods shop. That time he bought a... Yeah, no other 
words to describe it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
He's a soccer-maniac, so he'll like a soccer game, 
probably.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Huh, something from a bargain bin is fine then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh it's no problem at all, doesn't matter if the roster 
of players is dated, he'll enjoy it, so don't worry.
As long as it's a present from Sena, he'll be happy.

You're a lot better off compared to me, who was 
entrusted with Kirino's erotic games. Be thankful, 
Akagi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well then, we're done with the BL research and 
shopping for Akagi's present, so that's all for the 
day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's still pretty early though, wanna grab a bite 
before we head back?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ? What are you saying, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
We're not done. Or rather, we're just getting 
started.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?
A shiver ran down my spine.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That was just the opening act of the BL research. 
The real performance begins now.

...I don't really get it, but I can sense that great peril 
awaits!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Come on, let's get on the train.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, wait, where are you dragging me off to!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: The rose-colored paradise of course~

Where are we going at this hour... My head was 
crammed full of this rotten stuff, I think my head is 
starting to ferment...
